jobs.title: Electromechanical Lab Technician supporting Nvidia
jobs.description:
**Sustainable Talent** is partnering with **NVIDIA,** a global leader that has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 25 years. We are looking for a **Electromechanical** **Lab Technician** to support our client's lab operations team. This is a **full-time (W-2) contract** role based onsite in **Santa Clara, CA.** We offer competitive pay of **$30/hr - $45/hr** based on factors like experience, education, location, etc., and provide full benefits, PTO, and an amazing company culture!

  

In this role you will build, deploy, and support the hardware systems that engineers rely on every day, from bench-top development platforms to large server racks in the data center. You'll also bring ideas to life by designing and fabricating custom test fixtures and prototype components with CAD and 3D printing. This is an exciting opportunity to work hands-on with some of the most innovative technology in the world and help shape the labs where next-generation robotics and datacenter products are developed. Join us in revolutionizing the world of AI!

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Assemble, build, and install bench-top development platforms and large server systems in the bench lab and rack lab.
* Deploy systems and racks in the data center, connect power and network, and bring them up.
* Support parts replacement projects for small and large volume deployments.
* Prepare boards for detailed solder reworks to be completed by another lab.
* Connect oscilloscope probes to boards and collect signal waveform data.
* Perform mechanical reworks using power tools such as a Dremel.
* Design and produce CAD models and detailed drawings for custom test fixtures, and integrate designs into lab systems.
* Support the development, modification, and refinement of prototype components and fixtures, incorporating feedback from engineers and technicians.
* Use 3D printing and other rapid prototyping methods to fabricate, adjust, and assemble CAD-designed parts.
* Run laboratory tests on prototypes and make modifications to improve functionality and performance.

  

**What We're Looking For:**

* Hands-on experience with 3D CAD tools such as Creo, SolidWorks, OnShape, or Fusion 360 (Creo preferred but not required).
* Experience with prototyping, 3D printing, and manufacturing processes.
* Strong proficiency with hand tools and power tools.
* Familiarity with electrical wiring and basic system integration is a plus.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, hands-on lab environment alongside cross-functional engineering teams.

  

**About Sustainable Talent**

Sustainable Talent is a certified woman-owned company specializing in recruitment, consulting, and workforce solutions. We partner with innovative organizations to connect exceptional talent with meaningful opportunities across technology, engineering, operations, and professional services.

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sustainable Talent is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

jobs.title: Lead AI and Data Science Engineer II- Marketing Measurement
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in data and technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced **Lead** **AI and Data Science Engineer II** **- Marketing Measurement,** you will have the opportunity to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model tailored specifically for long-term, onsite client service delivery.  
  
**Work you'll do/Responsibilities**  
  
As a Lead AI and Data Science Engineer, you will provide technical and analytical leadership for marketing measurement initiatives. You will guide teams in designing rigorous measurement approaches, turning findings into investment recommendations, and improving the quality and consistency of analytics delivery.  

* Lead the design and evaluation of experimental and quasi-experimental analyses to measure marketing effectiveness and incremental impact.
* Set measurement approaches for geo-based test-and-control studies, paid media, and platform ecosystems such as Google and YouTube.
* Guide the application of causal inference, incrementality measurement, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), and A/B testing.
* Translate measurement results into clear recommendations on marketing strategy and investment allocation.
* Establish and promote standards for data validation, analytical quality, documentation, and communicating assumptions and limitations.
* Review analytical work and provide technical direction, coaching, and feedback to team members.
* Lead client workstreams, coordinate across business and technical teams, and manage priorities and delivery risks.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders in clear, business-friendly language; escalate material issues to engagement management.
* Identify opportunities to improve measurement processes, workflows, and outcomes.
* Communicate regularly with Engagement Managers (Directors), project team members, and representatives from various functional and / or technical teams, including escalating any matters that require additional attention and consideration from engagement management
* Independently and collaboratively lead client engagement workstreams focused on improvement, optimization, and transformation of processes including implementing leading practice workflows, addressing deficits in quality, and driving operational outcomes

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  
**The Team**  
  
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated solutions across software, data, AI, networks, and cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations. AI & Data teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms while delivering scalable, high-value outcomes tailored to their business needs.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Required**  

* 10+ years of relevant experience in data science, marketing analytics, marketing measurement, or a related field.
* Advanced SQL proficiency and substantial hands-on experience using Python or R for analysis.
* Demonstrated experience leading marketing measurement or analytics initiatives.
* Strong experience with MMM, causal inference, incrementality measurement, geo-based test-and-control design, experiment design, and A/B testing.
* Ability to assess data quality and analytical methods, and to explain limitations and assumptions.
* Proven ability to guide teams and communicate recommendations to senior business and technical stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
* Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

  
Preferred  

* Experience with campaign effectiveness management.
* Experience with customer segmentation.
* Experience measuring promotions management and effectiveness.
* Additional experience in marketing analytics.

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Robotics Research Assistant
jobs.description:
**Location: San Francisco, California — on-site**

**About Artificial Analysis**
-----------------------------

Artificial Analysis is the leading independent AI benchmarking company. We support labs, engineers, and enterprises to understand AI capabilities and make critical decisions about their AI strategies. We are the go-to authority for understanding AI, from AI labs and enterprises to media, investors, and policymakers. Our benchmarks don’t just measure the cutting edge of AI; they are actively shaping the frontier.

Our benchmarks and analysis are trusted by hundreds of thousands of users and are the go-to reference for leading AI labs including OpenAI, Google, Meta, NVIDIA, and Anthropic, and major publications including the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, the Financial Times, and The Economist.

We are a team of 50+, on track to double by year end, backed by Nat Friedman, Daniel Gross, Andrew Ng, Adam D’Angelo, Clem Delangue, and other industry leaders.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

The physical world is where the next generation of AI models will compete. We’re developing our robotics benchmarks to set the industry’s reference point: testing how AI models perform on physical robots and in simulation, and building the analysis that helps the industry understand them.

As a Robotics Research Assistant, you’ll work closely with our robotics researchers and engineers to run benchmarks and keep our robots built, calibrated, tested, and running. You’ll help build and maintain hardware, run our task suite, and set up new simulation environments as we add them.

This is a hands-on lab and benchmark-operations role. It suits a recent graduate or early-career candidate with substantial practical hardware experience who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and carefully running experiments. Expect to spend much of the day setting up, resetting, and monitoring trials.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Build and maintain an evolving suite of hardware.** Power, wire, and health-check hardware so each station is ready to run. Work efficiently to understand unfamiliar hardware and incorporate it into our fleet.
* **Run the task suite and read the results.** Set up task scenes, run startup and shutdown checks, and monitor trials on physical robots and in simulation.
* **Protect result quality.** Check that recordings and logs are complete and linked to the right task, model, and configuration. Record interventions and distinguish model failures from equipment, setup, or simulation faults.
* **Maintain the hardware.** Assemble hardware, route cables, mount fixtures and cameras, calibrate equipment, manage spare parts, and make the small mechanical fixes that keep a fleet running.
* **Keep the lab ready.** Carry out routine checks and maintenance, organize tools and spares, and follow lab safety procedures.
* **Improve how the lab runs.** Keep operating instructions current, flag recurring problems, and, where your skills allow, contribute fixtures, 3D-printed parts, or scripts.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* A recent graduate or early-career background in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field, with substantial hands-on hardware experience from labs, projects, internships, or similar practical work. We do not require two years of professional experience for this posting.
* Evidence that you have built, operated, maintained, or troubleshot robots, lab equipment, or electromechanical systems yourself.
* Practical troubleshooting: you can investigate a fault, test likely causes with appropriate tools, and explain what you learned.
* Careful execution of multi-step procedures, with strong attention to detail and reliable records.
* The ability to develop toward independently running a full day of trials after training, resolving routine problems, and recognizing when to ask for help.
* Clear communication and teamwork with researchers and engineers.
* Confidence picking up unfamiliar tools and software workflows.
* 3D printing experience, including through university or personal projects.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* ROS 2, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or another simulator you’ve debugged rather than just launched.
* Experience running benchmark or test campaigns where the count and ordering of trials matter.

**Growing With Us**
-------------------

Recent graduates are welcome to apply. We are a small, growing team working on one of the most interesting problems in AI. You do not need to tick every box. If you are curious and keen to learn, we will support you to develop your practical skills and take on more responsibility.

**Why Artificial Analysis?**
----------------------------

* **Shape how AI gets built.** Leading AI labs track our benchmarks and use them to guide their development priorities. Your work will help the industry understand how AI performs in the physical world.
* **Build expertise in frontier AI and robotics.** Work closely with researchers and engineers evaluating AI models on physical robots and in simulation.
* **Join at a defining moment.** We’re 50+ people, on track to double by year end, backed by some of the most connected investors in AI. The people who join now will shape the product, team, and strategy as we scale.
* Competitive compensation.

jobs.title: R&D Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

### **Transform the everyday with us!**

Siemens Electrification & Automation (E&A) Business Unit offers the full range of energy distribution systems and solutions for all markets and through all sales channels. We provide reliable power distribution grids of today while investing in our Future Grids portfolio to create the power distribution grid of the future. We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a phenomenal addition to our team!

**This role will be based onsite in Livermore, CA.** ***Local candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.*** Relocation assistance is not available for this role.

Livermore offers an excellent quality of life with top-rated schools, a pleasant climate, and easy access to both mountains and the coast. Plus, your compensation goes further here with a more attainable cost of living compared to other parts of the San Francisco Bay Area. It's the perfect blend of small-city charm and big-city access.

**We are seeking a meticulous and analytical R&D Laboratory Technician** to join our innovation team. In this role, you will work closely with technology leaders and engineers to support the design, development, and testing of new products, materials, and technologies. Your primary focus will be performing laboratory experiments, maintaining precise data logs, operating sophisticated testing equipment, and ensuring strict compliance with all laboratory safety protocols.

### **You’ll make a difference by:**

* Experiment Execution: Assist engineers in planning, setting up, and running controlled experiments, prototype trials, and product scale-ups.
* Prototype Preparation: Prepare, assemble, measure, and inspect for analytical testing.
* Data Collection & Analysis: Record experimental observations, calculate formulas, and compile test results accurately within electronic databases for documentation and use in progress reporting.
* Equipment Management: Operate, calibrate, clean, and perform routine preventative maintenance on laboratory instruments and machinery.
* Inventory Control: Monitor laboratory supply levels, track consumable resources, and coordinate with the procurement team to reorder chemicals, supplies or tools.
* Safety & Compliance: Adhere strictly to Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) regulations, and proper hazardous waste disposal procedures.
* Cross-Department Collaboration: Coordinate with quality control, manufacturing, and marketing teams to facilitate smooth transitions from product concepts to commercial manufacturing.

### **You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical theory, Engineering, Material Science, Physics, or a closely related scientific field.
* One or more years of hands-on laboratory experience, ideally in an industrial R&D, product testing, or quality control environment.
* Proficiency in standard analytical techniques (e.g., material testing, high voltage testing techniques, or physical testing methods) and experience tracking standard test protocols like ASTM or ISO.
* Proven digital skills, including demonstrable proficiency in MS Office (Excel) or Google Sheets, alongside familiarity with laboratory information management systems (LIMS) or scientific data software, and reporting.
* Excellent organizational habits, strong written communication skills for report drafting, and a natural ability to tackle technical anomalies independently or as part of a team.
* Ability to stand for extended periods, handle critical equipment, and safely lift up to 30 lbs when moving test equipment, experiments or raw materials.
* Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship now or in the future.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Electrical testing, including AC/DC Hipot testing, thermal cycle testing, BIL lightning testing, current injection testing, or thermocouples.
* Prior work experience in a research and development testing role in a manufacturing environment.

### **About Siemens:**

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

### **Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:**

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

jobs.title: Soils & Materials Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Hushmand Associates, Inc. (HAI), a geotechnical engineering and construction materials testing firm, is seeking experienced **Soils & Materials Laboratory Technicians** for the **Anderson Dam Seismic Retrofit Project in Morgan Hill, California**.

This is a full-time, project-based position supporting a major dam construction project **anticipated to last at least 7 years**, offering an opportunity for long-term employment.

The position primarily involves laboratory testing of soils, aggregates, and other construction materials in accordance with applicable ASTM and AASHTO standards and project specifications.

We are seeking dependable individuals with hands-on laboratory testing experience, strong attention to detail, proficiency in Microsoft Excel, and the ability to perform laboratory tests accurately and efficiently.

**Duties**

* Perform laboratory testing of soils, aggregates, and construction materials in accordance with applicable ASTM and AASHTO standards.
* Conduct Standard and Modified Proctor compaction tests (ASTM D698 and D1557).
* Perform sieve analysis, washed gradation, moisture content, Atterberg limits, specific gravity, and other soil classification tests.
* Conduct aggregate testing, including gradation, specific gravity, absorption, and other applicable tests.
* Perform additional laboratory testing of soils and aggregates as assigned.
* Prepare, process, and handle soil and aggregate samples for laboratory testing.
* Enter laboratory test data, measurements, and calculations accurately into Microsoft Excel spreadsheets.
* Complete laboratory testing worksheets using existing Excel templates and verify data entries for accuracy and completeness.
* Maintain organized laboratory testing records and documentation.
* Operate, maintain, and verify laboratory testing equipment.
* Follow laboratory quality control procedures, safety requirements, and project specifications.
* Communicate testing results, unusual findings, and testing issues promptly to laboratory supervisors.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory work environment.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Previous hands-on experience in geotechnical or construction materials laboratory testing.
* Minimum 3 years of laboratory testing experience preferred.
* Familiarity with ASTM and AASHTO laboratory testing procedures.
* Ability to independently perform common soils and aggregate laboratory tests.
* **Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required**, including data entry, basic formulas, and working with existing laboratory testing spreadsheets.
* Ability to accurately enter and review laboratory test data without altering existing spreadsheet formulas.
* Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations accurately, including percentages, unit conversions, and laboratory test calculations.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in recording and entering test data.
* Ability to maintain accurate testing records and documentation.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a laboratory team.
* Experience operating laboratory testing equipment and following quality control procedures.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

**Preferred Certifications**

* ACI Aggregate Base Testing Technician
* ACI Aggregate Testing Technician – Level 1
* ACI Aggregate Testing Technician – Level 2
* ACI Concrete Laboratory Testing Technician – Level 1
* Relevant Caltrans laboratory testing certifications

Candidates with substantial hands-on laboratory testing experience are encouraged to apply even if they do not currently hold all listed certifications.

**Additional Information**

* **Job Type:** Full-time, project-based
* **Work Location:** Anderson Dam Seismic Retrofit Project, Morgan Hill, CA 95037
* **Work Setting:** Onsite construction materials testing laboratory
* **Schedule:** Approximately 40 hours per week, with overtime as needed
* **Project Duration:** Anticipated to last at least 7 years
* **Compensation:** Based on experience and qualifications

Employment duration and work schedules are subject to project needs and workload.

Hushmand Associates, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician (On-site)
jobs.description:
RDI Trials runs clinical studies for diagnostic companies. Our laboratory supports those studies by receiving, processing, testing, storing, and shipping clinical research specimens.

We are hiring a Laboratory Technician to perform hands-on laboratory work from sample receipt through final disposition. You will report to the Lab Director and work closely with our laboratory and study teams. This is a full-time, onsite position in Van Nuys, Los Angeles.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Prepare for study samples

* Complete study-specific training and review sample volumes, specimen types, stability windows, labels, and manifests.
* Prepare freezer locations and supplies before shipments arrive.

Receive and track samples

* Receive, open, and sort sample shipments.
* Accession samples, reconcile shipments against manifests, and document discrepancies.
* Keep Salesforce and freezer location records accurate and complete.

Support laboratory testing

* Assess sample integrity and track protocol-defined testing windows.
* Perform assigned research testing and sample analysis in accordance with training, approved procedures, and applicable authorization.
* Run samples, calibrators, and quality controls on automated analyzers as assigned.
* Identify assay or instrument issues and escalate promptly to the Lab Director.
* Record and transmit results and complete study data entry accurately and on time.

Store and ship specimens

* Pull and organize samples against study manifests.
* Package and stage shipments according to protocols and applicable requirements.
* Update sample tracking and storage records after shipment.

Maintain laboratory readiness

* Perform routine equipment maintenance and calibration checks.
* Maintain temperature and humidity logs and complete laboratory records.
* Prepare study kits and track supplies, reagents, and consumables.
* Coordinate with vendors and obtain pricing for laboratory materials as requested.
* Identify risks and process improvements, communicate problems early, and follow issues through to resolution.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Samples are received, processed, tested, stored, and shipped accurately and on time. Records are complete and ready for review. Quality concerns and timeline risks are identified early, and the study team can rely on the laboratory to complete its commitments.

 **Requirements**

* Ability to follow study protocols, laboratory SOPs, and training requirements accurately.
* Careful sample handling, labeling, recordkeeping, and data entry.
* Ability to organize work around sample stability windows and study deadlines.
* Clear communication and prompt escalation of discrepancies, quality concerns, and conflicting instructions.
* Willingness to support routine laboratory work, equipment care, supplies, and study kit preparation.
* Ability to learn and use our laboratory information and sample tracking systems.
* Ability to work full time onsite in Van Nuys, Los Angeles.

Please describe your relevant laboratory experience, the instruments and specimen types you have worked with, and any experience supporting clinical research or mass-spectrometry studies.

 **Benefits**

Base salary: $70,000 per year.

Everyone who joins RDI has the opportunity to participate in the RDI Operator Studio as part of their long-term growth here. Through hands-on work, coaching, and review of real study problems, you can deepen your expertise, learn how the whole business works, and earn broader responsibility as your judgment develops. You enter through this role; your growth does not have to stop at its original scope.

jobs.description:
Merge Labs is a frontier research lab with the mission of bridging biological and artificial intelligence to maximize human ability, agency and experience. We’re pursuing this goal by developingfundamentally new approaches to brain-computer interfaces that interact with the brain at high bandwidth, integrate with advanced AI, and are ultimately safe and accessible for anyone to use.

**About the team:**

Our Bio team designs, builds, and characterizes the biotechnologies that form the foundation of next-generation brain-computer interfaces. We combine molecular engineering, synthetic biology, neuroscience, and advanced physical methods such as ultrasound to establish less invasive, high-bandwidth connections with neurons. We develop and validate our core molecular technologies in close collaboration with engineers, data scientists, and in vivo researchers.

**About the role:**

We are seeking a Research Associate to help develop and characterize neuronal models for ultrasound-based molecular actuation . You will establish and maintain neuronal culture systems, introduce engineered constructs, and evaluate their expression, localization, and function. Working closely with molecular biology, neuroscience, and in vivo teams, you will generate reproducible data that guide actuator development and optimization. This is a hands-on role for someone with strong neuronal culture skills who enjoys troubleshooting experiments and developing new methods.

**In this role, you will:**

* Establish, maintain, and characterize neuronal cell culture systems, including primary, stem cell-derived, or brain slice models.
* Perform transfections and viral transductions to introduce engineered constructs into cells.
* Execute microscopy and cell-based assays to assess construct expression, localization, and function.
* Collaborate with molecular biology, neuroscience, and in vivo teams to design experiments, interpret results, and inform iterative tool optimization.
* Troubleshoot experiments and contribute to protocol development, optimization, and standardization.
* Maintain accurate experimental records, culture histories, and sample metadata, and communicate results clearly across teams.

**You might thrive in this role if you have:**

* A BS or MS in Bioengineering, Neuroscience, Cell Biology, or a related discipline, with hands-on laboratory experience.
* Experience with one or more neuronal systems, including primary neurons, iPSC-derived neurons, acute or organotypic brain slice cultures.
* Experience with transfection, viral transduction, microscopy, or cell-based assays.
* A systematic approach to troubleshooting and strong attention to experimental quality, reproducibility, and documentation.
* A collaborative, organized approach to laboratory work and enthusiasm for tackling foundational neurotechnology problems in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary team.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with protein or genetic circuit engineering.

jobs.title: Research Associate, Applied Cell Line Development & Customer Programs
jobs.description:
Prolific Machines is ushering in a new era of biotechnology with light. Our first-of-its-kind optogenetic platform delivers unprecedented control, precisely guiding cellular behavior when and where it matters most. Unlike existing tools used to control biology, our technology enables dynamic, tunable control over virtually any cellular function in any cell type. We're enabling partners to unlock robust efficiency, quality, and reproducibility advantages across the most complex pharmaceuticals and therapeutic proteins. Prolific is supported by leading investors, including Bill Gates’s Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Mayfield and SOSV.

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Research Associate to help advance our mammalian cell line development and protein production capabilities. At Prolific, we use light to control the expression of biotherapeutic proteins, with the goal of increasing titer and improving quality attributes. In this role, you will play a key part in generating and characterizing cell lines that support both internal research and customer programs. * Handle protein production workflows at different scales - deep well plates and shake flasks, potentially including small scale bioreactors such as the Ambr system
* Execute downstream readouts such as cell counting (Celleca, nucleocounter), metabolite measurements (Nova / CEDEX), Octet BLI, flow cytometry
* Perform single cell isolation using methods such as FACS, cell deposition, or Beacon
* Execute plasmid cloning and molecular biology techniques including PCR and ddPCR
* Conduct experiments independently, collect and analyze data in a timely manner, maintain detailed documentation in electronic lab notebooks, and data visualization and presentation in team meetings

### **Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Biology, Bioengineering, Biotechnology, or a related field, with relevant laboratory experience in mammalian cell culture. Candidates will be considered at the Research Associate I, Research Associate II, and Senior Research Associate levels based on their experience, technical proficiency, and demonstrated independence.
* Proficient in mammalian cell culture, preferably with experience in cell line development, and are well versed in sterile technique, transfection, and clone isolation
* Comfortable with readouts such as cell counting, metabolite measurement, Octet BLI and flow cytometry
* Comfortable with developing and proposing experimental plans, conducting experiments, and troubleshooting analytical techniques and methodologies
* Proficient in precisely following protocols, designing and executing experiments independently, and managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced setting
* Self-starter who’s committed to team science and effective independent work

new_jobs.title: Robotics Research Assistant
new_jobs.description:
**Location: San Francisco, California — on-site**

**About Artificial Analysis**
-----------------------------

Artificial Analysis is the leading independent AI benchmarking company. We support labs, engineers, and enterprises to understand AI capabilities and make critical decisions about their AI strategies. We are the go-to authority for understanding AI, from AI labs and enterprises to media, investors, and policymakers. Our benchmarks don’t just measure the cutting edge of AI; they are actively shaping the frontier.

Our benchmarks and analysis are trusted by hundreds of thousands of users and are the go-to reference for leading AI labs including OpenAI, Google, Meta, NVIDIA, and Anthropic, and major publications including the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, the Financial Times, and The Economist.

We are a team of 50+, on track to double by year end, backed by Nat Friedman, Daniel Gross, Andrew Ng, Adam D’Angelo, Clem Delangue, and other industry leaders.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

The physical world is where the next generation of AI models will compete. We’re developing our robotics benchmarks to set the industry’s reference point: testing how AI models perform on physical robots and in simulation, and building the analysis that helps the industry understand them.

As a Robotics Research Assistant, you’ll work closely with our robotics researchers and engineers to run benchmarks and keep our robots built, calibrated, tested, and running. You’ll help build and maintain hardware, run our task suite, and set up new simulation environments as we add them.

This is a hands-on lab and benchmark-operations role. It suits a recent graduate or early-career candidate with substantial practical hardware experience who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and carefully running experiments. Expect to spend much of the day setting up, resetting, and monitoring trials.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Build and maintain an evolving suite of hardware.** Power, wire, and health-check hardware so each station is ready to run. Work efficiently to understand unfamiliar hardware and incorporate it into our fleet.
* **Run the task suite and read the results.** Set up task scenes, run startup and shutdown checks, and monitor trials on physical robots and in simulation.
* **Protect result quality.** Check that recordings and logs are complete and linked to the right task, model, and configuration. Record interventions and distinguish model failures from equipment, setup, or simulation faults.
* **Maintain the hardware.** Assemble hardware, route cables, mount fixtures and cameras, calibrate equipment, manage spare parts, and make the small mechanical fixes that keep a fleet running.
* **Keep the lab ready.** Carry out routine checks and maintenance, organize tools and spares, and follow lab safety procedures.
* **Improve how the lab runs.** Keep operating instructions current, flag recurring problems, and, where your skills allow, contribute fixtures, 3D-printed parts, or scripts.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* A recent graduate or early-career background in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field, with substantial hands-on hardware experience from labs, projects, internships, or similar practical work. We do not require two years of professional experience for this posting.
* Evidence that you have built, operated, maintained, or troubleshot robots, lab equipment, or electromechanical systems yourself.
* Practical troubleshooting: you can investigate a fault, test likely causes with appropriate tools, and explain what you learned.
* Careful execution of multi-step procedures, with strong attention to detail and reliable records.
* The ability to develop toward independently running a full day of trials after training, resolving routine problems, and recognizing when to ask for help.
* Clear communication and teamwork with researchers and engineers.
* Confidence picking up unfamiliar tools and software workflows.
* 3D printing experience, including through university or personal projects.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* ROS 2, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or another simulator you’ve debugged rather than just launched.
* Experience running benchmark or test campaigns where the count and ordering of trials matter.

**Growing With Us**
-------------------

Recent graduates are welcome to apply. We are a small, growing team working on one of the most interesting problems in AI. You do not need to tick every box. If you are curious and keen to learn, we will support you to develop your practical skills and take on more responsibility.

**Why Artificial Analysis?**
----------------------------

* **Shape how AI gets built.** Leading AI labs track our benchmarks and use them to guide their development priorities. Your work will help the industry understand how AI performs in the physical world.
* **Build expertise in frontier AI and robotics.** Work closely with researchers and engineers evaluating AI models on physical robots and in simulation.
* **Join at a defining moment.** We’re 50+ people, on track to double by year end, backed by some of the most connected investors in AI. The people who join now will shape the product, team, and strategy as we scale.
* Competitive compensation.

new_jobs.title: Soils & Materials Laboratory Technician
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**

Hushmand Associates, Inc. (HAI), a geotechnical engineering and construction materials testing firm, is seeking experienced **Soils & Materials Laboratory Technicians** for the **Anderson Dam Seismic Retrofit Project in Morgan Hill, California**.

This is a full-time, project-based position supporting a major dam construction project **anticipated to last at least 7 years**, offering an opportunity for long-term employment.

The position primarily involves laboratory testing of soils, aggregates, and other construction materials in accordance with applicable ASTM and AASHTO standards and project specifications.

We are seeking dependable individuals with hands-on laboratory testing experience, strong attention to detail, proficiency in Microsoft Excel, and the ability to perform laboratory tests accurately and efficiently.

**Duties**

* Perform laboratory testing of soils, aggregates, and construction materials in accordance with applicable ASTM and AASHTO standards.
* Conduct Standard and Modified Proctor compaction tests (ASTM D698 and D1557).
* Perform sieve analysis, washed gradation, moisture content, Atterberg limits, specific gravity, and other soil classification tests.
* Conduct aggregate testing, including gradation, specific gravity, absorption, and other applicable tests.
* Perform additional laboratory testing of soils and aggregates as assigned.
* Prepare, process, and handle soil and aggregate samples for laboratory testing.
* Enter laboratory test data, measurements, and calculations accurately into Microsoft Excel spreadsheets.
* Complete laboratory testing worksheets using existing Excel templates and verify data entries for accuracy and completeness.
* Maintain organized laboratory testing records and documentation.
* Operate, maintain, and verify laboratory testing equipment.
* Follow laboratory quality control procedures, safety requirements, and project specifications.
* Communicate testing results, unusual findings, and testing issues promptly to laboratory supervisors.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory work environment.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Previous hands-on experience in geotechnical or construction materials laboratory testing.
* Minimum 3 years of laboratory testing experience preferred.
* Familiarity with ASTM and AASHTO laboratory testing procedures.
* Ability to independently perform common soils and aggregate laboratory tests.
* **Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required**, including data entry, basic formulas, and working with existing laboratory testing spreadsheets.
* Ability to accurately enter and review laboratory test data without altering existing spreadsheet formulas.
* Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations accurately, including percentages, unit conversions, and laboratory test calculations.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in recording and entering test data.
* Ability to maintain accurate testing records and documentation.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a laboratory team.
* Experience operating laboratory testing equipment and following quality control procedures.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

**Preferred Certifications**

* ACI Aggregate Base Testing Technician
* ACI Aggregate Testing Technician – Level 1
* ACI Aggregate Testing Technician – Level 2
* ACI Concrete Laboratory Testing Technician – Level 1
* Relevant Caltrans laboratory testing certifications

Candidates with substantial hands-on laboratory testing experience are encouraged to apply even if they do not currently hold all listed certifications.

**Additional Information**

* **Job Type:** Full-time, project-based
* **Work Location:** Anderson Dam Seismic Retrofit Project, Morgan Hill, CA 95037
* **Work Setting:** Onsite construction materials testing laboratory
* **Schedule:** Approximately 40 hours per week, with overtime as needed
* **Project Duration:** Anticipated to last at least 7 years
* **Compensation:** Based on experience and qualifications

Employment duration and work schedules are subject to project needs and workload.
